about: Bitwig's BtWg format: a typed object tree (see Parsers/BitwigFormat.cs). Class ids and field ids are numbered separately, and a field id means the same in every class it appears in. Worked out from projects saved by Bitwig 5.1, 5.2 and 6.1.

classes.name: file reference
classes.about: Where a file is: 0x3b its full path, with 0x38 the computer and 0x3a the user it was saved by.

classes.name: Bitwig device
classes.about: One of Bitwig's own devices, as a device in a chain refers to it (0x197): 0x99 which device, 0x9a its name, 0x9b vendor, 0x9c category, 0x9d kind.

classes.name: key lane
classes.about: One key's notes in a clip: 0xee the key, 0x21f the notes. Bitwig keeps one lane per key, highest key first.

classes.name: clip
classes.about: A note clip: 0x2af where it starts and 0x26 its length, in beats; 0x2ae9 holds what's in it; 0x10f8 set when it's muted.

classes.name: plugin setting automated
classes.about: What an automation lane moves when it's a plugin's setting: 0xec the device, 0xed the setting's path in it, 0x133b and 0x133a the names shown on the lane.

classes.name: note
classes.about: 0x2af where it starts, in beats from the start of its clip; 0x26 its length; 0xef its velocity (0 to 1).

classes.name: device chain
classes.about: A track's devices, in order, in 0x144.

classes.name: track
classes.about: 0xf its ID, 0x15b its name (empty: named after its first device), 0x54c its colour, 0x164 its devices, 0x165 its mixer, 0x168 per-user view state.

classes.name: device in a chain
classes.about: A device on a track. 0x197 says which device (a Bitwig device, VST3 or VST2 plugin).

classes.name: mixer
classes.about: A track's mixer: 0x1a4 volume, 0x1a5 pan and 0x1a6 mute settings, 0xa5 its sends.

classes.name: clip content
classes.about: What's in a clip; 0x49c holds its notes. The track lists every clip's content in 0x2aed.0x10e6.

classes.name: CONTENTS
classes.about: A Bitwig device's settings, in 0x20c, each named in 0x2b9.

classes.name: mixer setting automated
classes.about: What an automation lane moves when it's a mixer setting: 0x41 the setting (volume or pan), 0x133b "Mixer" and 0x133a the lane's name.

classes.name: OCTAVES setting
classes.about: Note Transpose's octaves: 0x273 is the octaves plus 3.

classes.name: automation point
classes.about: 0x2af its time in beats, 0x28f its value, 0xba6 its curve, 0x359e always 1 so far.

classes.name: COARSE setting
classes.about: Note Transpose's semitones: 0x330, a signed byte.

classes.name: VST2 plugin
classes.about: A VST2 plugin as a device in a chain refers to it: 0x9a name, 0x9b vendor, 0xce4 its VST2 ID, 0xbe5 its settings file in the project's zip (an .fxb or .fxp).

classes.name: VST2 plugin in a chain
classes.about: A VST2 plugin's place in a device chain: 0xf its ID, 0x197 the plugin itself (0x1a5). Laid out like a VST3's (0x729).

classes.name: group
classes.about: A group of tracks, and the project's own top group (0x4dd): 0x4de its tracks, 0x4df effect tracks, 0x4e0 the master.

classes.name: file hash
classes.about: 0x16 holds the MD5 of a whole sample file, which is how Bitwig recognises it.
classes.proof: Checked against the sample's MD5; Bitwig opened projects the app wrote with it

classes.name: Sampler zone
classes.about: 0x75c the root key, 0x75d fine tune (probably), 0x75f and 0x761 the end in seconds, 0x4112.0x748 the sample.
classes.proof: Solomon's bitwig_test (6.1.3); root key confirmed in Bitwig

classes.name: SAMPLE setting
classes.about: The Sampler's sample, a CONTENTS item: 0x74c its zone.

classes.name: automation lane
classes.about: A lane in a track's 0x2dc9.0x4ba: 0x2a3 what it moves, 0x2d8c.0x35ac.0x21f its points.

classes.name: hardware device
classes.about: A hardware instrument or effect: 0x11a7 its name.

classes.name: sample file
classes.about: 0x512 the file's name, 0xd3b where it is, 0x513 its MD5, 0x17 its size in bytes.

classes.name: sample
classes.about: 0x129f the file's name, 0x94 sample rate, 0x95 length in seconds, 0x96 channels, 0x129e the file.

classes.name: tempo
classes.about: The project's tempo, a setting like any other: 0x2bd "TEMPO", 0x2c8 the tempo in BPM.

classes.name: VST3 plugin
classes.about: A VST3 plugin as a device in a chain refers to it: 0x9a name, 0x9b vendor, 0x9c category, 0xce4 its class ID, 0xbe5 its settings file in the project's zip (a .vstpreset).

classes.name: VST3 plugin in a chain
classes.about: A VST3 plugin's place in a device chain: 0xf its ID, 0x197 the plugin itself (0x728). Automation of its settings points here (0x65's 0xec).

classes.name: warp marker
classes.about: In an audio clip's warp markers (0x192): 0x2af the beat and 0xa6 the second of the sample there.

classes.name: audio playback
classes.about: How an audio clip's event plays its sample: 0x20d.0x4b4 the sample, 0xc33 its transposition, 0x192 its warp markers, 0x10ea its transients, 0x4b0 its stretch mode.

classes.name: audio event
classes.about: An audio clip's one event, in 0x2ae9.0x10e9.0x49c.0x18cb[0].0x21f: 0x2af its start and 0x26 its length in beats, 0xc05 where the sample ends, 0x288 how it plays.

classes.name: audio clip
classes.about: An arrangement audio clip (a clip of notes is 0x47): 0x2af where it starts and 0x26 its length, in beats; 0x2adb where play starts and ends in the sample; its content holds one audio event (0xd4).

fields.name: ID
fields.about: An object's own ID (tracks, groups, devices). Copies get new ones; 0x99 is different: it names which Bitwig device it is.

fields.name: MD5
fields.about: In a file hash (0x1e2): the MD5 of the whole sample file.
fields.proof: Checked against the sample's MD5; Bitwig opened projects the app wrote with it

fields.name: file size
fields.about: In a sample file (0x4a6): its size in bytes, in the smallest integer type that holds it.

fields.name: length
fields.about: A length in beats: of a clip, a note, or a loop range.

fields.name: computer name
fields.about: In a file reference: the computer the path was saved on.

fields.name: user name
fields.about: In a file reference: the user the path was saved by.

fields.name: path
fields.about: In a file reference: the file's full path.

fields.name: mixer setting
fields.about: In a mixer setting automated (0xf1): the setting the lane moves, the track's volume or pan (0x1a4, 0x1a5).

fields.name: per-user project state
fields.about: On the project: view state by user name (selected track, open editors). The FL Studio converter empties it.

fields.name: sample rate
fields.about: In a sample (0x4a9).

fields.name: sample length
fields.about: In a sample (0x4a9): its length in seconds.

fields.name: channels
fields.about: In a sample (0x4a9): 1 mono, 2 stereo.

fields.name: device ID
fields.about: In a Bitwig device (0x40): which device it is, the same in every project and as DAWproject's deviceID. Sampler is 468bc14b-b2e7-45a1-9666-e83117fe404e, Note Transpose 0815cd9e-3a31-4429-a268-dabd952a3b68.
fields.proof: Solomon's bitwig_test and note_transpose (6.1.3); the app finds the Drum Machine's this way

fields.name: device name
fields.about: The name of a Bitwig device or plugin, as Bitwig shows it.

fields.name: vendor
fields.about: Who made a device or plugin.

fields.name: category
fields.about: A device's category, e.g. Synth, Delay, Audio FX.

fields.name: device kind
fields.about: 0 audio effect, 1 note effect, 2 instrument.

fields.name: device on
fields.about: On a device's definition (the 0x40, 0x728 or 0x1a5 a device instance's 0x197 holds): 0 when the device is switched off with its power button, 1 when it's on. Not the same id as class 0xa3 (a device instance).
fields.proof: Solomon's Bitwig 6.1 saves: 0 on exactly the two devices Bitwig's own DAWproject export of the same project marks Enabled false, 1 on every other device in 7 projects; BitwigProjectTests.MutesWhatAnAutomatedChannelPlaysWhileItsOffAndCarriesItsInsertsEffects

fields.name: contents
fields.about: A Bitwig device's settings (CONTENTS, class 0xd3).

fields.name: sends
fields.about: In a mixer (0xab): its sends to effect tracks. The FL Studio converter empties it.

fields.name: curve
fields.about: In an automation point: 0 is a straight line to the next point; other values not checked.

fields.name: plugin settings file
fields.about: The name of the plugin's settings file in the project's zip, under plugin-states/.

fields.name: plugin location
fields.about: Where the plugin's file is: 0xc5b lists file references to it.

fields.name: plugin files
fields.about: In a plugin location: file references (0x2a) to the plugin.

fields.name: plugin version (probably)
fields.about: Cleared by the converter for a plugin other than the template's, so Bitwig reads it again on load.

fields.name: plugin ID
fields.about: A VST3 plugin's class ID in hex, or a VST2 plugin's unique ID.

fields.name: on
fields.about: In an on/off setting, such as a mixer's MUTE (0x1a6, class 0x4ce): 1 when it's on.

fields.name: file
fields.about: In a sample file (0x4a6): the file reference (0x2a).

fields.name: device
fields.about: In a plugin setting automated (0x65): the device the lane moves a setting of.

fields.name: setting path
fields.about: In a plugin setting automated (0x65): CONTENTS/ROOT_GENERIC_MODULE/PID<hex> for a VST3 setting, PARAM<number> for a VST2 one.

fields.name: key
fields.about: In a key lane: the MIDI key its notes play.

fields.name: velocity
fields.about: A note's velocity, 0 to 1.

fields.name: release velocity (probably)
fields.about: Saved with each note; the converter sets it to the note's velocity.

fields.name: setting value
fields.about: A CONTENTS setting's value, in the setting's own units (TRANSPOSE in semitones).

fields.name: devices
fields.about: In a device chain: the devices, in order.

fields.name: name
fields.about: A track's or group's name; empty means Bitwig names it after its first device.

fields.name: device chain
fields.about: A track's devices (class 0x8a).

fields.name: mixer
fields.about: A track's mixer (class 0xab).

fields.name: per-user track state
fields.about: A track's view state by user name. The converter empties it.

fields.name: device definition
fields.about: In a device in a chain: which device (a 0x40 Bitwig device, 0x728 VST3 or 0x1a5 VST2 plugin).

fields.name: device display name (probably)
fields.about: On a device in a chain; the converter sets it to the sample's name on a Sampler.

fields.name: volume
fields.about: In a mixer: the VOLUME setting. Its value (0x2c8) is the cube root of the gain: 1.0 is 0 dB, 1.26 is +6 dB.

fields.name: pan
fields.about: In a mixer: the PANORAMA setting, -1 to 1 with 0 the centre.

fields.name: mute
fields.about: In a mixer: the MUTE setting.

fields.name: automated settings
fields.about: On a plugin: the settings it has automated, each with 0x1319 the setting's ID and 0x131a a value.

fields.name: setting ID
fields.about: An automated setting's ID in the plugin.

fields.name: setting's value
fields.about: Saved with an automated setting; the converter puts the first point's value there.

fields.name: lane name
fields.about: The name an automation lane shows for what it moves.

fields.name: lane device name
fields.about: The device an automation lane belongs to, as shown ("Mixer" for volume and pan).

fields.name: plugin outputs (probably)
fields.about: Its 0x8e0 list is cleared by the converter for a plugin other than the template's.

fields.name: outputs (probably)
fields.about: In 0x137c: the plugin's outputs as the template's plugin had them.

fields.name: clip contents
fields.about: On a track (0x2aed) or a lane (0x2aec): the contents of its clips.

fields.name: clip content
fields.about: In 0x2ae9: what's in the clip (class 0xbf). In an audio playback's 0x10ea: its transients.

fields.name: muted
fields.about: On a clip or a note: 1 when it's muted.

fields.name: hardware name
fields.about: A hardware device's name, e.g. Elektron Analog Rytm MKII.

fields.name: sample file
fields.about: In a sample: the file (class 0x4a6).

fields.name: sample name
fields.about: In a sample: the file's name.

fields.name: preset name
fields.about: The preset a device was loaded from, if any.

fields.name: 0 for effect plugins
fields.about: Bitwig saves 0 here on effect plugins; meaning unknown.

fields.name: plugin browser entry holder
fields.about: On a plugin device (0x728, 0x1a5): holds 0x17cc, its copy of Bitwig's browser entry for the plugin.

fields.name: plugin browser entry
fields.about: Inside 0x17cd: Bitwig's browser entry for the plugin, a small BtWg document of its own (path and class ID, name, vendor, version, the VST3 folder).

fields.name: key lanes
fields.about: In a clip's note content: one key lane (0x42) per key.

fields.name: program name
fields.about: In 0x1b75: the plugin's program name. The converter empties it for a plugin other than the template's.

fields.name: program
fields.about: On a plugin: its program (0x1b72 the name).

fields.name: settings
fields.about: In CONTENTS: a device's settings, each named in 0x2b9.

fields.name: items
fields.about: A list that means what holds it: a key lane's notes, an arrangement's clips, a lane's points.

fields.name: octaves
fields.about: In an OCTAVES setting: octaves plus 3, so 3 is none and 6 is +3.

fields.name: point value
fields.about: An automation point's value: 0 to 1 for a plugin setting, the mixer's own units for volume and pan.

fields.name: automated
fields.about: In an automation lane: what it moves, a mixer setting (0xf1) or a plugin setting (0x65).

fields.name: clip content holder
fields.about: On a clip: 0x10e9 is what's in it.

fields.name: loop
fields.about: On a clip: 0x992 its loop range, 0x98c and 0x98d where play starts and ends (probably), in beats from the clip's start.

fields.name: lane clip contents
fields.about: On an automation lane: 0x10e6 the contents of its clips.

fields.name: track clip contents
fields.about: On a track: 0x10e6 lists the content of every one of its clips.

fields.name: start
fields.about: A position in beats: where a clip starts, a note starts (from its clip's start), or an automation point is.

fields.name: setting name
fields.about: A CONTENTS setting's name, e.g. TRANSPOSE, SAMPLE, FILT_FREQ, AMP_ATTACK_TIME, TRACK_SEND(...).

fields.name: setting ID
fields.about: A setting's ID, e.g. VOLUME, PANORAMA, MUTE, TEMPO.

fields.name: track timeline
fields.about: On a track: 0x2d8e holds its arrangement clips.

fields.name: group timeline
fields.about: On the project group: its 0x2d8b.0x21f lists clips (the converter empties it; probably the clip selection).

fields.name: value
fields.about: A setting's value: the tempo in BPM, a mixer fader, a pan.

fields.name: group clips
fields.about: In the group timeline: 0x21f a list of clips.

fields.name: lane timeline
fields.about: On an automation lane: 0x35ac.0x21f its points, 0x21f its clips.

fields.name: arrangement
fields.about: In a track timeline: 0x21f the track's arrangement clips.

fields.name: clip launcher
fields.about: In a track timeline (0x2bf8): 0x231 the track's clip launcher slots, one per scene.

fields.name: launcher slots
fields.about: In a clip launcher (0x2d8f): its slots (class 0xe3), one per scene. Where a filled slot keeps its clip isn't mapped yet: the preview looks for a clip anywhere inside it.

fields.name: automation
fields.about: On a track: 0x4ba its automation lanes.

fields.name: coarse
fields.about: In a COARSE setting: semitones as a signed byte (-4 is 252).

fields.name: point flag
fields.about: Saved as 1 in every automation point seen so far; meaning unknown.

fields.name: points
fields.about: In a lane timeline: 0x21f the lane's points.

fields.name: automation list
fields.about: In a track's automation (0x2dc9) beside its lanes; the converter empties it; meaning unknown.

fields.name: zone sample
fields.about: In a Sampler zone: 0x748 its sample.

fields.name: notes
fields.about: In a clip's content: 0x18cb its key lanes.

fields.name: lanes
fields.about: In a track's automation (0x2dc9): its automation lanes.

fields.name: per-user lane state
fields.about: On an automation lane: view state by user name. The converter empties it.

fields.name: project group
fields.about: On the project: the top group that holds every track.

fields.name: tracks
fields.about: In a group: its tracks and groups, in order.

fields.name: effect tracks
fields.about: In the project group: the effect (return) tracks.

fields.name: master track
fields.about: In the project group: the master track, usually a reference to where it was first written.

fields.name: file name
fields.about: In a sample file: the file's name.

fields.name: file hash
fields.about: In a sample file: its MD5 (class 0x1e2).

fields.name: colour
fields.about: A track's colour.

fields.name: sample
fields.about: In a zone's sample holder: the sample (class 0x4a9).

fields.name: zone
fields.about: In the SAMPLE setting: the Sampler zone (class 0x210).

fields.name: root key
fields.about: In a Sampler zone: the root key as a MIDI note (57 is A2).

fields.name: fine tune (probably)
fields.about: In a Sampler zone.

fields.name: zone end
fields.about: In a Sampler zone: the sample's end in seconds. 0x761 holds the same in the template; which is which isn't known.

fields.name: zone end (second)
fields.about: In a Sampler zone: also the sample's end in seconds in the template.

fields.name: play start (probably)
fields.about: In a clip's loop: 0x2af where play starts.

fields.name: play end (probably)
fields.about: In a clip's loop: 0x2af where play ends.

fields.name: loop range
fields.about: In a clip's loop: 0x2af its start and 0x26 its length.

fields.name: loop on (probably)
fields.about: In a clip's loop (0x2adb): 1 when the clip loops its loop range (0x992), going by its place; 0 in every clip seen so far.

fields.name: summary tracks
fields.about: In the summary (metadata "structure"): the tracks, with the names Bitwig shows.

fields.name: summary effect tracks
fields.about: In the summary: the effect tracks.

fields.name: shown name
fields.about: In the summary: a track's name as Bitwig shows it (filled in when the track's own name is empty).

fields.name: summary project
fields.about: In the summary: the project's tracks.

fields.name: audio playback
fields.about: In an audio event (0xd4): how it plays its sample (class 0x9f).

fields.name: sample holder
fields.about: In an audio playback (0x9f): 0x4b4 the sample.

fields.name: played sample
fields.about: In 0x20d: the sample an audio clip plays (class 0x4a9).

fields.name: clip name (probably)
fields.about: On a clip's content: its name, probably. The app writes it only where the template's clip has it.

fields.name: sample start (probably)
fields.about: In an audio event: where it starts in the sample, in seconds, going by 0xc05. The app writes 0.

fields.name: sample end (probably)
fields.about: In an audio event: where the sample ends, in its seconds; a guess that matched the test save.

fields.name: stretch mode
fields.about: In an audio playback: how Bitwig stretches the clip. 3 is what Bitwig saved for a clip stretched and transposed; other values not checked.

fields.name: transposition
fields.about: In an audio playback: its pitch, an expression (class 0x2af) with one point (0x108) whose 0x28f is the semitones. Empty when it isn't transposed.

fields.name: warp markers
fields.about: In an audio playback: 0x21f its warp markers (class 0x43).

fields.name: sample time
fields.about: In a warp marker: the time in the sample, in seconds.

fields.name: transients
fields.about: In an audio playback: 0x10e9.0x21f the transients Bitwig found in the sample. The app empties them so Bitwig finds the new sample's own.

fields.name: transients flag (unknown)
fields.about: Next to an audio clip's transients; the app sets it to 0 when it empties them. Meaning not checked.

fields.name: point field (unknown)
fields.about: In a transposition's point: saved as 0. Meaning unknown.

fields.name: expression flag (unknown)
fields.about: In a transposition (class 0x2af): saved as 0. Meaning unknown.

meta.name: Bitwig version
meta.about: The Bitwig version that saved the file, e.g. 6.1.3.

meta.name: summary
meta.about: A small Bitwig document of its own: the tracks with the names Bitwig shows, for its browser.

meta.name: used files
meta.about: Files the project uses, relative to its folder (collected copies get -2 suffixes).
